description: Domain composition of KRT9 vs other keratins, and positional mapping of EPPK1 variants
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def get(acc):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json", timeout=60).json()
    return r

k9 = get("P35527")
seq = k9["sequence"]["value"]

# Regions from UniProt
head = seq[0:152]; rod = seq[152:465]; tail = seq[465:623]
coil1A = seq[152:188]; coil2 = seq[322:461]

def comp(s, name):
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(s); n=len(s)
    gly = 100*c['G']/n; ser=100*c['S']/n; tyr=100*c['Y']/n
    chg = 100*(c['D']+c['E']+c['K']+c['R'])/n
    print(f"{name:<10} n={n:<4} Gly={gly:5.1f}%  Ser={ser:5.1f}%  Tyr={tyr:5.1f}%  charged(DEKR)={chg:5.1f}%")
    return gly, ser, chg

print("=== KRT9 (P35527) domain composition ===")
rows = {}
for s,n in [(seq,"full"),(head,"head"),(rod,"rod"),(tail,"tail")]:
    rows[n]=comp(s,n)

# Compare Gly+Ser content of head+tail across type I keratins
others = {"KRT9":"P35527","KRT10":"P13645","KRT14":"P02533","KRT16":"P08779","KRT1(typeII)":"P04264","KRT6C(typeII)":"P48668","KRT17":"Q04695"}
print("\n=== Gly+Ser fraction of non-rod (head+tail) across keratins ===")
res={}
for name,a in others.items():
    r=get(a); s=r["sequence"]["value"]
    # locate rod
    rodf=[f for f in r["features"] if f["type"]=="Domain" and "IF rod" in f.get("description","")]
    if rodf:
        st=rodf[0]["location"]["start"]["value"]; en=rodf[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]
        nonrod = s[:st-1]+s[en:]
    else:
        nonrod=s
    g = nonrod.count('G')/len(nonrod); ss=nonrod.count('S')/len(nonrod)
    res[name]=(100*g,100*ss,len(nonrod),len(s))
    print(f"{name:<14} len={len(s):<4} nonrod={len(nonrod):<4} Gly={100*g:5.1f}%  Ser={100*ss:5.1f}%  Gly+Ser={100*(g+ss):5.1f}%")

# ---- Figure ----
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.6))

names=list(res.keys()); gl=[res[n][0] for n in names]; se=[res[n][1] for n in names]
order=np.argsort([-(gl[i]+se[i]) for i in range(len(names))])
names=[names[i] for i in order]; gl=[gl[i] for i in order]; se=[se[i] for i in order]
x=np.arange(len(names))
axes[0].bar(x, gl, color="#3b6ea5", label="Glycine")
axes[0].bar(x, se, bottom=gl, color="#c0763a", label="Serine")
axes[0].set_xticks(x); axes[0].set_xticklabels(names, rotation=40, ha="right", fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_ylabel("percent of residues")
axes[0].set_title("Gly and Ser content of head plus tail domains")
axes[0].legend(frameon=False)

# EPPK variant positions along the protein
variants=[f for f in k9["features"] if f["type"]=="Natural variant"]
pos=sorted(set(f["location"]["start"]["value"] for f in variants))
axes[1].axhspan(0,1, xmin=0, xmax=152/623, color="#dddddd")
for (a,b,c,lab) in [(1,152,"#dddddd","head"),(153,188,"#d94f4f","1A"),(189,207,"#f0f0f0",""),
                    (208,299,"#8aa9c9","1B"),(300,322,"#f0f0f0",""),(323,461,"#d94f4f","2"),
                    (462,623,"#dddddd","tail")]:
    axes[1].axhspan(0,1, xmin=(a-1)/623, xmax=b/623, color=c)
    if lab: axes[1].text((a+b)/2, 0.5, lab, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9)
for p in pos:
    axes[1].plot([p,p],[1.05,1.5], color="k", lw=1.2)
    axes[1].plot(p,1.55,'v',color="crimson",ms=5)
axes[1].set_xlim(0,623); axes[1].set_ylim(0,2.0)
axes[1].set_yticks([])
axes[1].set_xlabel("residue position")
axes[1].set_title("EPPK1 disease variants map to the rod ends (n=%d positions)"%len(pos))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nEPPK variant positions:", pos)
print("Fraction of variant positions inside helix initiation motif (153-172):",
      sum(1 for p in pos if 153<=p<=172), "/", len(pos))
print("Inside helix termination motif (~440-461):", sum(1 for p in pos if 440<=p<=461), "/", len(pos))
